# dsh-tab-status-light
**Put the AI session state on your browser tab icon** — a plugin for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI.
English · 繁體中文
## English

While a turn runs, the tab icon blinks gray; when the turn finishes it turns green;
while the sessio

n waits for you it turns yellow; when a turn is interrupted it turns red.
You can tell the state of

the agent at a glance — even from another tab — without
switching back to the app.
| State | Color | Animation | Derived from |
| Working | gray `#9ca3af` | blinks every 600 ms: **the plain whale** ↔ whale + gray dot (the off ha

lf has no dot at all) | `SessionStatus.running === true` |
| Done | green `#22c55e` | lit for 10 s,
then back to the plain whale | a turn **seen running here** whose last `turn/end` reason is not an i

nterruption |
| Waiting for you | yellow `#eab308` | stays lit until you answer | `SessionStatus.pen

dingInteraction !== undefined` (question / approval / plan review) |
| Interrupted | red `#ef4444` |
lit for 20 s, then back to the plain whale | a turn **seen running here** whose last `turn/end` rea
son is `aborted` / `blocked` / `error` / `interrupted` |

The shipped whale is left untouched when no session is selected, when the session has
not finished a

turn yet, or when you merely **switch to a session that finished long ago**
— green/red are news ab

out something that just happened, not a replay of history.
`SETTLE_MS` (green, 10 s) and `SETTLE_MS_

RED` (red, 20 s) control how long a settled
badge stays; any new finished turn lights it again. An i

nterruption keeps the tab red for
its full 20 s even if the next turn finishes inside that window, s

o a cancel is never
silently overwritten by a completion.
### Install

The plugin ships as a DSH bundle (`dsh.bundle.patch`). Install it with the harness
`plugin_manager`:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Or from the CLI:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Or point at a checkout (handy while developing — edits apply on page reload):
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Reload the page (`Cmd+R` / `Ctrl+R`) after installing.

> Requires the harness Web profile with the `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-session` and
> `@deepseek-ai

/dsh-api-session-controller` client packages available (a standard
> install has both).
### How it works

- **Pure Client plugin, occupies no slot**: it reads `ctx.sessions.list` (which session
is the main

view) and `ctx.uiSession.sessionStatus` (running / pending interaction),
and follows the session's e

vent source for the newest `turn/end` reason.
- The icon is **redrawn from the live favicon**: it `f

etch()`es the shipped
`favicon.svg` / `favicon-dark.svg`, splices one `<circle>` in before `</svg>`,

and
swaps the `href` of `<link rel="icon">` to a data URL (Chrome repaints the tab icon).
The origi

nal `href` is restored on teardown.
- Because of that, the whale artwork is never copied into this p

lugin — upstream logo
changes carry over automatically.
- Badge geometry inside the shipped 50×50 vi

ewBox: `cx=37, cy=37, r=11, stroke-width=4`;
the ring uses the tab background (dark `#35363a`, light

`#ffffff`) to separate the dot
from the mark.
- Blinking is driven by a tiny Web Worker, so it **ke

eps blinking while the tab is in
the background** (Chrome throttles page timers in hidden tabs). It

falls back to a
page timer where workers are unavailable.
- Both blink halves are precomputed data U

RLs, so every swap paints on the tick — no
file re-read, which is what made the pulse look uneven in

paints on the tick — no
file re-read, which is what made the pulse look uneven in earlier versions.
### Tuning
All at the top of `client.js`:
| Constant | Default | Meaning |

| `BADGE` | `{cx:37, cy:37, radius:11, ring:4}` | dot position / radius / ring width |
| `BADGE_COLO

R` | gray / green / yellow / red | state colors |
| `BLINK_MS` | `600` | blink period while working

|
| `SETTLE_MS` | `10000` | how long the green badge stays |
| `SETTLE_MS_RED` | `20000` | how long

the red badge stays |
| `RED_TURN_END_KINDS` | `aborted` `blocked` `error` `interrupted` | turn endi
ngs that count as interruptions |
### Resource use

Blinking costs about **2 ms of JS per second** (≈0.2 % of one core); when idle it costs
nothing — no
timers, no rescans.
### Known limits

- The icon reflects the **main view** session only; background sessions are not shown.
- Switching t

o a session that finished earlier does not flash green (only a turn watched
running lights up).
- Bl

inking continues in a background tab, but a **frozen** tab (Chrome Memory Saver /
battery saver) sto

ps all page JS — no web API can bypass that. To keep it alive, add the
origin to `chrome://settings/

performance` → "Always keep these sites active".
`navigator.wakeLock` does **not** help: it only kee

ps the screen awake and is released
as soon as the page is hidden.
- When a frozen or backgrounded t

ab wakes up, the plugin resyncs and repaints immediately,
so the icon is always correct when you loo

k at it.
- It swaps SVG data URLs into `<link rel="icon">`; very old browsers without SVG favicon
su
pport will show no change.
### Development
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Edit `client.js`, then reload the page: the Client module is served from disk.

## 繁體中文
**把 AI 的狀態畫在瀏覽器分頁圖示上** —— 一個給 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 用的外掛。
[该节后续省略]
### 已知限制

- 圖示只反映**主視窗**那個 session；其他背景 session 不會顯示。
- 切換到「早就跑完」的 session 不會亮綠燈（只亮真的看到跑完的那一輪）。
- 分頁在背景仍會閃；但被*

*凍結**（Chrome Memory Saver／省電模式）時任何網頁的 JS 都會停，
沒有 API 可以繞過。想讓它一直閃，把網址加進 `chrome://settings/performanc

e` →
「永遠讓這些網站保持運作」。`navigator.wakeLock` **沒有用**：它只防螢幕休眠，分頁一隱藏就被釋放。
- 分頁解凍／切回前景時會立刻重新同步並重畫，所以看到的時候一定是

正確狀態。
- 用 SVG data URL 換 `href`，不支援 SVG favicon 的舊瀏覽器看不到變化。
